career_ladder.note: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) is the apex statutory regulatory body for the insurance and reinsurance sector in India, established under the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999. Headquartered in Hyderabad with regional offices in New Delhi and Mumbai, Assistant Managers (Grade A) are recruited across Actuarial, Finance, Law, IT, Research, and Generalist streams. Promotion follows regulatory commission cadres benchmarked alongside RBI and SEBI.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Assistant Manager (Grade A) in IRDAI is conducted through a three-phase process: Phase I Online Preliminary Examination (Objective, 160 marks, 90 minutes), Phase II Descriptive Examination (3 Papers of 100 marks each, 60 minutes per paper = 300 marks total), followed by Phase III Interview. In Phase I, a negative marking deduction of 1/4th (0.25) mark applies for every wrong answer. Final merit ranking gives 85% weightage to Phase II and 15% weightage to the Interview.

financial_package.note: Assistant Managers (Grade A) in IRDAI receive starting basic pay of ₹44,500 per month in the scale of ₹44,500 - 2,500(4) - 54,500 - 2,850(7) - 74,450 - EB - 2,850(4) - 85,850 - 3,300(1) - 89,150. Total initial monthly gross emoluments are approximately ₹1,30,000 to ₹1,46,000 per month (inclusive of Grade Allowance, Special Allowance, Dearness Allowance, and House Rent Allowance).

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Grade A entry basic pay of ₹44,500 with Dearness Allowance, Grade Allowance, Special Allowance, Local Compensatory Allowance, and House Rent Allowance (or Authority-leased accommodation in Hyderabad); net salary accounts for standard defined pension (NPS) and statutory deductions.
official_perks: Authority-leased residential accommodation in Hyderabad / metropolitan posting centers
Comprehensive medical facility / full reimbursement of medical expenses for self and dependent family

Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and leave encashment provisions

competition_benchmarks.note: IRDAI recruits Assistant Managers (Grade A) across multiple disciplines (Generalist, Actuarial, Finance, Law, IT, and Research). In the 2024 recruitment cycle, 49 vacancies were notified, following 45 vacancies notified in the 2023 cycle.
